description.purpose: The submitter's whole memory, as ONE table: `submissions`, one row per submission in flight. `kind` separates the two uses of the same row -- `flight` is the FIFO correlation of the receipt (#438), `parked` is the manifest waiting out a broker round trip (#435). One table, because both rows describe the SAME submission and a sweeper would otherwise have to know two places.
description.use_when: Inside the submit hive only, and reached only by `./gate`. A `code` cell has no `cell.db` (`docs/cell-types.md` § code), so the round trip to this store IS the gate's memory: the state of a multi-phase submission rides in the hop keys the internal edges promote to context and comes back on this store's answer.
description.not_in_scope: It decides nothing and it checks nothing. It holds no policy -- the verdict is the gate's or, from #435 onward, the broker's -- and it holds no secret. `contract.write_surface` is `internal` because the audit trail of the one privileged lane in the tree may not have a second writer: the hive declares `params.ports: []`, so the only address is the hive path, and the only sender inside it is the gate.
